# satuuu99

> satuuu99 is a small, private wellness studio at Manhagener Allee 45, 22926 Ahrensburg, Germany, roughly 25 km northeast of central Hamburg. One treatment room, four practitioners, eleven treatments. All treatments are wellness and care rituals, not medical treatments.

## Treatments

Eleven treatments across four areas. Confirmed prices and durations appear in the official price list; prices for the anti-stress gua sha massage and Bellabambi are also listed below.

Head
- Japanese Head Spa — scalp and hair cleansing and care plus head, neck and shoulder massage, lying down. Hair gets wet. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/head-spa

Face
- Aqua Facial — water-based cleansing with gentle suction, then hydration and care. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/aqua-facial
- Sleep & Glow — the calmest facial: no device, low light, long slow massage. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/sleep-glow
- Gua Sha — slow facial massage with a smooth stone across face, jaw and throat. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/gua-sha

Feet
- Wellness foot care — warm foot bath, nails, dry skin, finishing cream. Cosmetic, not podiatry. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/foot-care
- Foot massage — feet and lower legs with oil, in a reclining chair, no undressing. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/foot-massage

Body
- Anti-stress gua sha massage — head, neck, shoulders and back with Thai massage movements, stretches and gua sha. 30 min €45, 45 min €60, 60 min €70. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/anti-stress-gua-sha
- Bellabambi — intense, device-led treatment for tense areas: back, shoulders, fascia, legs, feet and face. 45 min €60, 60 min €70. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/bellabambi
- Cupping massage — moving cupping glasses on oiled skin, combined with classic strokes. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/cupping-massage
- Candle massage — body-warm oil from a massage candle, even and unhurried. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/candle
- Steam massage — wellness massage with moist heat; availability varies, ask first. https://www.satuuu99.de/behandlungen/steam

## Common questions

- Does hair get wet during a Japanese Head Spa? Yes — warm water and cleansing of scalp and hair are part of the ritual. The hair is rinsed and gently dried at the end; elaborate styling is not included.
- Is satuuu99 in Hamburg? No. The studio is in Ahrensburg, roughly 25 km northeast of central Hamburg, about 25–35 minutes by car via the A1.
- Do I have to undress? Only for the body massages, and underwear stays on; you lie draped in linen. Head spa needs no undressing; facials loosen the top; foot rituals need shoes and socks off.
- Which facial should I choose? Aqua Facial for cleansing, Sleep & Glow for rest, gua sha for focused touch across jaw and throat.

## Boundaries

- satuuu99 does not diagnose, prescribe or treat medical complaints.
- Not offered: physiotherapy, prescribed medical massage, dermatological treatment, injectables, microneedling, laser treatment, medical peels, acne therapy, podiatry.
- Guests are asked to seek medical advice first for pain, inflammation, injury, unexplained symptoms or hair loss under investigation.
- Photography on the website is licensed wellness photography of comparable rituals, labelled as atmosphere imagery where it is not documentation of the actual premises.
